pages.text: The $(item)Blueprint Repository$() is a library block. Deposit a written disc and the build joins a browsable catalogue.$(br2)Select any entry and $(l)burn$() it back onto a blank disc, as often as you like.

pages.title: Depositing Discs
pages.text: Drop a $(l)written$() Blueprint Disc into the input slot and press $(l)Deposit Disc$(). The build is catalogued into the library and the disc is consumed.$(br2)Once catalogued you can re-burn as many copies as you like, and it stays until somebody $(l)removes$() it on purpose.

pages.title: Duplicates Recycle
pages.text: Depositing a disc you already hold gives the disc back as a $(l)blank$() rather than filing a duplicate.$(br2)The catalogue holds one entry per build, so a shared library never fills with copies of the same thing.

pages.title: STL to Disc
pages.text: Select a build in the list, drop a $(item)Blank Blueprint Disc$() into the input slot, and press $(l)STL to Disc$() to burn a fresh written disc.$(br2)Burned copies keep the original's $(l)official$() or $(l)player-scan$() status, so the Resin anti-dupe rule still holds.

pages.title: Renaming Scans
pages.text: The scanner names a capture after where you stood: $(o)Scan @ 307,70,10$(). Select a scan and a $(l)rename$() field appears; type a name and press $(l)Set$().$(br2)$(l)Player scans only$(), and only by whoever deposited it, or an $(l)operator$(). Official builds keep their shipped names.$(br2)Names cap at 48 characters.

pages.title: Removing a Scan
pages.text: Select an entry and press $(l)Del$() $(o)twice$(): the button arms first and reads $(l)Sure?$() for five seconds.$(li)Whoever $(l)deposited$() it can remove it$(li)$(l)Operators$() can remove anything$(li)$(l)Official$() builds cannot be removed$(br2)Removal takes the entry only, never the blueprint: a disc burned earlier still prints.

pages.title: Shared or Personal
pages.text: By default a repository is a $(l)shared, world-level$() library: everyone's deposits pool together, every repository block sees the same catalogue, and breaking a block never loses it.$(br2)Server admins can flip $(l)blueprintRepositoryIsShared$() to $(l)false$() in the config for $(l)personal$() per-player libraries instead.
The Blueprint Repository. One per base is plenty: it's the home for every build you collect.
